_docs._warning: This is an example configuration file. Fill in the values with your own data.
_docs._warning_1: Dont edit the docs section, only edit the values above.
_docs._comment: Elevated Plus Maze arena configuration. Fill in the 12 maze points using ImageJ.
_docs._NOTE_ImageJ_2: Make sure the points are in the same order as the _point_order list.
_docs._NOTE_ImageJ_3: Use the point tool to create a ROI and then save as arbitrary x,y coordinates.
_point_order: top-open arm: top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left
right-closed arm: top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left
bottom-open arm: top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left (same order as top arm, opposite side)
left-closed arm: top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left
